mode: Independent read-only source review with disposable synthetic local fixtures; only evidence files written in workspace.

tests.command: Independent inline Node synthetic profile/session checks
details: selected profile reports only its own stale checkpoint
same session in another owner profile cannot reuse checkpoint
another native session cannot reuse checkpoint
ready-shaped checkpoint with retained failure does not use stale-success guidance
newer compatible runtime retains stale and unconfirmed reporting

validated: Fresh completed checkpoint remains ready through 19999 ms; at exactly 20000 ms stale success is labeled stale with automatic delivery unconfirmed; next completed checkpoint restores readiness.
Stale-success reporting requires verified session, current-or-newer receiver runtime, exact host-session match, ready state, no retained failure and an aged integer timestamp.
Old runtime reports upgrade-required; dead PID and lock mismatch resolve stopped; reconnecting, stopped, startup, wrong host and unverified identity do not receive stale-success guidance.
Isolated stale-success guidance contains no helper/reconnect/reinstall instruction, exposes only timestamp and age, and does not rewrite status or lock evidence.
Synthetic secondary owner profile and different session do not reuse the primary checkpoint; active-profile cached account reporting remains separate.
Ready-shaped checkpoint with a retained failure cannot be presented as stale success; newer compatible runtime remains accepted for reporting.
Automatic-delivery expression is byte-identical to baseline; conductor-receiver and mailbox-client hashes are identical to baseline, preserving 20-second readiness and dispatch/eligibility.
Existing setup credential redaction, read-only behavior, scoped diagnostics, runtime/version guidance and permission-denial guidance pass focused suite.
limitations: Synthetic local evidence only; no production calls, receiver startup, native messages, account/permission changes, source edits or package work performed.
Owner isolation is inherited from the existing selected profile directory and verified session contract; patch adds no new ownership or tool-level grant.
Stale reporting describes uncertainty only and is not host delivery or message-read evidence.
Before-failure snapshot remains under .context/end-to-end-repair/before-receiver-reporting; this review independently compared replay68 and ran final tests without rerunning the before suite.
